reconciliation_findings: The current official Mykonos shop collection reports 54 products, while an independent fragrance database lists 84 Mykonos perfumes. These are different scopes and should not be forced to match.

The Mykonos branch snapshot in PR #426 reports 72 canonical identity records. This exceeds the current official shop collection count, so each of the 72 needs reconciliation for discontinued items, new releases, collaborations, duplicates and non-fragrance formats.

The Velixir range is listed as 28 perfumes by an independent index, while the official brand website is the primary reference. The PR #426 snapshot reports 28 Velixir identities; compare names and aliases before adding anything.
